scenes.label: Serena alone · Identity monologue
scenes.location: Villa interior; city / Prime Group montage

shots.action: James steps to Serena, takes her hand; she stays composed
shots.evidence_visual: Their clasped hands in foreground; soft villa interior bokeh
shots.notes: Open; 9:16 bottom subtitle safe zone; calm before cut

shots.action: James delivers the confession; Serena’s face stays controlled
shots.evidence_visual: James mouth CU on dialogue; cut to Serena eyes reacting without screaming
shots.notes: Retain James line on-screen / VO sync: “Honey, I’ve fallen in love with another woman.”

shots.action: Serena asks who; James answers; her jaw tightens
shots.evidence_visual: Two-shot; Serena’s grip on wineglass / furniture edge white-knuckle

shots.action: Flash: Amy on campus, hardworking student look
shots.evidence_visual: Campus path; Amy with backpack/books; soft daylight

shots.action: Evidence flash of scholarship paperwork Serena funded
shots.evidence_visual: Close-up: need-based scholarship award letter, $100,000 figure, Serena signature
shots.notes: Evidence beat: she built the scholarship

shots.action: James gestures passionately comparing Amy to Serena; Serena listens cold
shots.evidence_visual: James animated mid-shot; Serena still profile; optional street-food flash with Amy

shots.action: Serena draws the divorce line; James agrees confidently
shots.evidence_visual: Two-shot standoff; James nodding; Serena steel-eyed
shots.notes: Retain Serena: “If that’s what you want, then let’s get divorced.”

shots.evidence_visual: Serena extreme close-up; eyes go steel; end on her face freeze
shots.notes: Retain Serena: “If you want love so badly, then go live without money. James Miller, the game begins now.”

shots.action: Serena alone; VO identity open; bitter clarity
shots.evidence_visual: Serena standing alone in living room; soft ambient; title-card feel of her name
shots.notes: VO: Her name is Serena Harris…

shots.action: Montage of what she gave: sneakers overnight, studio funding, scholarship signing
shots.evidence_visual: Sneaker box delivery CU; bank/funding transfer UI; scholarship signing with Amy present

shots.action: Reveal: heiress / Prime Group / city holdings; smash back to betrayal
shots.scene: City skyline + Prime Group HQ insert → villa present
shots.evidence_visual: LA skyline night; Prime Group logo/building; half city commercial map glow; smash to Serena face
shots.notes: Identity bomb; keep facts: daughter of LA’s wealthiest / Prime Group hundreds of billions

shots.action: Serena dials Kate; split: villa desk / Kate office
shots.evidence_visual: Phone screen: Kate; Serena cold executive posture; Kate listening with notepad

shots.action: Order 1 cutaways: divorce draft, reclaim Bentley + studio shares
shots.evidence_visual: Divorce papers stamp; Bentley keys/logo; studio share certificates stacked

shots.action: Orders 2–3: investigate Amy, cut scholarship/card; blacklist Amy + cut James funding citywide
shots.evidence_visual: Rivertown University crest; cancelled scholarship stamp; red ‘never hire’ list with Amy; partner termination emails
shots.notes: Both unable to find a job in this city

shots.action: Serena at floor-to-ceiling window watches James kiss Amy downstairs
shots.evidence_visual: Serena reflection on glass; below: James+Amy kissing; villa lights warm vs her cold silhouette
shots.notes: Emotional peak; designed villa / 6 months / 3 years obsession VO

shots.action: Ownership reclaim evidence + final war vow close-up
shots.scene: Villa interiors as empty trophies → Serena CU
shots.evidence_visual: Prime Group deed on villa; company Bentley plate; studio investment docs; final Serena eyes CU
shots.notes: VO vow: crush everything… Amy loses the halo I gave her. End card energy.
